statusLine.command: input=$(cat); branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null | sed 's|.*/||'); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); tokens=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.total_input_tokens // empty'); out="$branch"; [ -n "$used" ] && { tok_display=""; [ -n "$tokens" ] && tok_display=" ($(echo "$tokens" | awk '{if($1>=1000000) printf "%.1fM",$1/1000000; else if($1>=1000) printf "%.0fk",$1/1000; else print $1}'))" ; out="$out | ctx: $(printf '%.0f' "$used")%${tok_display}"; }; echo "$out"
